blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY— Bulusan Volcano in Sorsogon recorded 438 volcanic earthquakes in 24 hours, more than double the 205 reported in the previous advisory, raising concerns over possible steam-driven eruptions. The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs), in its Nov. 15 bulletin, said the earthquakes were recorded from midnight of Nov. 14 to midnight of Nov. 15. The increased seismic activity indicates continued unrest beneath the volcano, which remains under Alert Level 1, or low-level unrest. Phivolcs warned that the heightened seismicity could increase the likelihood of phreatic, or steam-driven, eruptions from any of Bulusan’s summit vents. READ: Bulusan Volcano logs […]...
